sample.pendingForTarget: No sample has been read for the selected PLC: {plcKey}

configCapability: Current configuration is read from YAML/env. View and select a PLC here; editing, connection tests and managed persistent connections are planned for later stages.
pointsCapability: Files are identified automatically. Enter each actual DB number, select blocks, then preview the delta. UDTs have no DB number. Existing blocks update only with valid source proof; renumbering, renaming or leaf removal is blocked. For changed sources, explicitly select an existing target. Unselected blocks retain their old versions.

sourceImport.help: Files are identified automatically. Enter each actual DB number, select blocks, then preview the delta. UDTs have no DB number. Existing blocks update only with valid source proof; renumbering, renaming or leaf removal is blocked. For changed sources, explicitly select an existing target. Unselected blocks retain their old versions.
sourceImport.ready: The selected set can be confirmed as a draft. Acquisition readiness still requires separate review.
sourceImport.blocked: The selected set has blocking issues. The current draft is unchanged. Deselect problem blocks and preview again.
sourceImport.preservation: Keep {points} existing points / {manual} manual addresses; invalidate {invalidated} address confirmations.
sourceImport.layoutChanged: Declaration order, type or layout dependencies changed. All address confirmations in this target DB are invalidated; address values and manual reasons are retained.
sourceImport.udtIsolation: Only selected DBs use the new UDT version. Other DBs retain the old version.
sourceImport.readiness: Existing draft readiness (advisory for structural import)
sourceImport.manualConflict: Manual address differs from the theoretical layout; its value and reason are retained.
sourceImport.layoutProfile: Profile: {profile}; complete explicitly non-optimized standard layout only. Preview does not save addresses. Confirmation changes non-manual addresses only. Field addresses require separate site verification.
sourceImport.chooseHint: Choose .db / .udt files. Cancelling keeps the previous input.
sourceImport.lengthEditHint: Length edits remain unsaved in the draft. After closing, use Save draft in the configuration bar. Closing does not save.
sourceImport.lengths: Configured DB length: {current} bytes · Calculated length: {calculated} bytes

naming.explicitHint: Only explicitly selected points are converted. Legacy and manual changes appear below. Cancel writes nothing and retains selection. Any pending address or conflict blocks the whole confirmation.
naming.editHint: Name changes require a valid ASCII technical name; the original path stays. Address confirmation and pending name generation commit in this save. Failures retain input.
